title: Remediation Backlog Tier Policy
source: Non-Tech Change Management with AI Assistance Playbook — brownfield adoption of pre-existing projects

discoveryOrder: Pointer line in PROJECT.md Security Notes (authoritative — records the path chosen at adoption time)
defaultPath whose first line is the marker

tiers.BLOCKING: Must reach status FIXED before check-golive-readiness may return READY. The agent never waives a BLOCKING item; a waiver requires a named Information Security sign-off recorded on the finding AND in PROJECT.md Review Evidence.
tiers.ADVISORY: Legacy finding in pre-existing code: documented with a migration note, fixed during normal work, never blocks the gate. New or modified code must comply immediately — the always-on guardian rules are not relaxed.

defaultTierNote: Any finding type not mapped below is BLOCKING. Downgrades are made by editing this policy file, never ad hoc in a backlog.

map.match: Hardcoded secret, credential, key, or token in code or git history
Should-fix hardening finding with no known exploit path
License policy violation (forbidden or unresolvable license)
OSV vulnerability rated critical, or any severity with known exploitation
OSV vulnerability below critical with no known exploitation
map.note: Upgrade during normal work; new dependencies are still rejected by check-dependency.

map.match: Hold-ring or unlisted technology already present in pre-existing code
map.note: Legacy repos (Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) stay ADVISORY unless a major improvement (new module/service, DB migration, new frontend app, runtime/framework/ORM/DB swap, major upgrade) is in progress; then a tech-architect approval row in PROJECT.md ## Stack Exceptions is required. Migration note required. New code must not add or extend hold-ring technology.
Fix opportunistically, or via /fix-structure when the owner schedules it.

map.match: UI not conforming to the Blu design system
map.note: New screens use @acme/rnd-svelte.* components themed with BLUE DLS design tokens (@acme/blue-design-tokens); legacy Vue repos use BLUE DLS Vue 3. BLUE UI guidance lives in the separate company BLUE marketplace.

map.match: Login method other than Apps Gateway SSO or Company Google OAuth
Code not hosted in the approved company org / approved platform
